Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". - code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). - loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). ## Summary of Todo Filter Modes

I've conducted a thorough search of the panopt codebase and found **two parallel implementations** of todo filter modes - one in the Zellij sidebar plugin and one in the viewer pane. Here are my findings:

### PRIMARY DEFINITIONS

#### 1. **panopt-zellij-logic** (Sidebar Plugin Logic)
**File**: `/home/gregz/cp/panopt/crates/panopt-zellij-logic/src/lib.rs`

- **Enum definition** (lines 110-121):
  ```rust
  #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default)]
  pub enum TodoFilter {
      All,
      Open,
      #[default]
      OpenUnblocked,
      InProgress,
      Backlog,
      Draft,
      Completed,
      NotDone,
  }
  ```

- **Filter array** (lines 123-132): `ALL_TODO_FILTERS[8]` - the cycle order for `f`/`F` keys
- **Label mapping** (lines 135-146): `label()` method returns display strings ("all", "open", "open-unblocked", etc.)
- **Filter logic** (lines 167-185): `includes_label()` method - matches projection suffix labels; note that `OpenUnblocked` **degrades to `Open`** in sidebar since projection lacks blocker info
- **Wire format** (lines 190-199): `to_wire()`/`from_wire()` for stable serialization
- **Type documentation** (lines 101-109): Explains OpenUnblocked degradation and blocker-aware behavior difference from viewer pane

#### 2. **panopt** (Viewer Pane)
**File**: `/home/gregz/cp/panopt/crates/panopt/src/viewer.rs`

- **Enum definition** (lines 188-198):
  ```rust
  #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
  enum TodoFilter {
      All,
      Open,
      #[default]
      OpenUnblocked,
      InProgress,
      Backlog,
      Draft,
      Completed,
      NotDone,
  }
  ```

- **Filter array** (lines 265-274): `ALL_FILTERS[8]` - matches sidebar cycle order
- **Label mapping** (lines 202-213): `label()` / `as_key()` methods return same display strings
- **Filter logic** (lines 246-260): `includes()` method - uses full blocker-aware logic on `ListEntry` with `is_blocked` field
- **Parse method** (lines 223-229): Loads filter from viewstate with forward-compatibility fallback
- **Type documentation** (lines 181-186): Notes OpenUnblocked is the default working set; user cycles with `f`/`F`

### CYCLING & KEYBINDING

#### Zellij Sidebar Plugin
**File**: `/home/gregz/cp/panopt/crates/panopt-zellij/src/main.rs`

- **Cycle function** (lines 1188-1202): `cycle_todo_filter(forward: bool)` - calls `.next()` or `.prev()` on the enum, rebuilds items, updates title
- **Keybinding** (lines 1435-1436):
  ```rust
  BareKey::Char('f') if self.mode == Mode::Todos => self.cycle_todo_filter(true),
  BareKey::Char('F') if self.mode == Mode::Todos => self.cycle_todo_filter(false),
  ```
- **Help text** (lines 704-707): Shows current filter in help overlay
- **Title display** (lines 641-670): Filter label shown in frame title `[filter-name]` and preserved when truncating

#### Viewer Pane
**File**: `/home/gregz/cp/panopt/crates/panopt/src/viewer.rs`

- **Cycle function** (lines 808-825): `cycle_filter(forward: bool)` - no-op when not on TodoList, updates filter, adjusts cursor to visible range, persists to viewstate
- **Keybinding** (lines 630-631):
  ```rust
  KeyCode::Char('f') => self.cycle_filter(true),
  KeyCode::Char('F') => self.cycle_filter(false),
  ```
- **Filter application** (lines 789-790): In `visible_indices()` method, filters entries via `self.todo_filter.includes(e)`

### PERSISTENCE & STATE

**File**: `/home/gregz/cp/panopt/crates/panopt/src/viewstate.rs`

- **Viewstate storage** (line ~): `extras` map stores `{ "todo_filter": "open-unblocked" }` per-target
- **Viewer loads on startup** (viewer.rs line 493-497): Restores `todo_filter` from viewstate or defaults to `OpenUnblocked`
- **Viewer saves on change** (viewer.rs line 898-899): Persists via `as_key()` method

### KEY INSIGHTS

1. **Two implementations**: Sidebar reads only projection index (no MCP), so `OpenUnblocked` approximates as `Open`. Viewer uses MCP and applies full blocker-aware filtering.
2. **8 filter states**: All, Open, OpenUnblocked (default), InProgress, Backlog, Draft, Completed, NotDone
3. **Cycling**: `f` / `F` keys cycle forward/backward through the same 8-item cycle in both UIs
4. **Label format**: Displayed as dash-separated (e.g., "open-unblocked", "in_progress") in UI and viewstate
5. **Filtering logic**: Each variant matches on todo `status` field + for `OpenUnblocked`, additionally requires `!is_blocked`

Done. Todo #156 is complete.

## What I did

Added a combined **`active`** todo filter — *(open & unblocked) | in-progress* — and made it the new default, replacing the old `open-unblocked` filter exactly as the todo suggested. The win: starting a todo no longer makes it vanish from the default view.

Implemented in both filter implementations (they mirror each other):

- **`crates/panopt/src/viewer.rs`** (MCP-backed viewer pane) — `Active` = `(status == "open" && !is_blocked) || status == "in_progress"`, full blocker-aware.
- **`crates/panopt-zellij-logic/src/lib.rs`** (sidebar plugin) — `Active` = `status == "open" || status == "in_progress"`; the open-unblocked half degrades to plain "open" since the projection index carries no blocker info (same degradation pattern that already existed).
- **`crates/panopt/src/viewstate.rs`** — updated the persisted-shape doc example.

### Migration is clean
- Viewer persists the string key; old stored `"open-unblocked"` no longer matches and falls back to the default — which is now `active`.
- Sidebar persists a wire int indexing `ALL_TODO_FILTERS`; I swapped the variant in-place at the same index (2), so an old code `2` decodes straight to `Active`.

Title/help text in the sidebar render from `.label()`, so they pick up "active" automatically.

### Verification
- `just check` — **PASS** (workspace + wasm plugin)
- `just clippy` (`-D warnings`) — **PASS** (workspace + wasm plugin)
- Tests — **PASS**: updated `active_shows_unblocked_open_and_in_progress` (now expects in-progress visible), plus wire round-trip and filter-cycle tests all green (159 + 26 passed).

Note: kept `Open` and `InProgress` as distinct filters in the cycle so you can still isolate either one; only `OpenUnblocked` was replaced. Changes are unstaged on branch `agent-model` — let me know if you want them committed.
